offering_vpnEmpresarial.name: Enterprise VPN
offering_vpnEmpresarial.tagline: Secure remote access with WireGuard, MFA and SIEM
offering_vpnEmpresarial.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "Enterprise VPN". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with connected employees
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and connected employees

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of connected employees
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of connected employees
incluye: Architecture aligned with SOC 2/ISO 27001 (certification at customer expense)
Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_vpnEmpresarial.costoNote: VPN servers (~$30–$25,000 USD/mo), SIEM and enterprise ZTNA are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
